description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeObject' which is part of the HTMLPurifier library. The class provides a module to safely embed objects (such as Flash objects) within HTML, ensuring security by applying specific attribute transformations and configurations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeObject
classes.description: A module that enables the safe embedding of objects (e.g., Flash) within HTML documents, ensuring security by applying specific attribute configurations and transformations.
